description: A `${` whose body holds a quote that reaches its line end unclosed has no balanced `}`: it is E-MD-INTERP-UNCLOSED, never a slot stitched through the code span's closing backtick to a `}` on a later line (which would swallow that prose into an expression).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 `<md>` F1 "a" (`${…}` inside `<md>` is TEXT-ONLY) · ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 Q21 "I like a." (what you type is what is shown)
rationale: §67.2: the splitter takes the §4.18.1b token-depth extent, found by lexing the interpolation body; a quote with no closing quote on its line is not a string token, so the `${` has no balanced closing `}` before `</md>` — E-MD-INTERP-UNCLOSED, whose message names `<pre>`. §67.4: a slot inside a code span is shown literally; no text of the body is ever consumed as an expression.
